name: Europa Clipper
best_known_for: Largest planetary spacecraft ever launched (6065 kg); first mission dedicated to characterising the habitability of Jupiter's moon Europa
credit: Added with /fly mission JSON (#341 batch 5). 100-m² solar arrays — the largest interplanetary photovoltaic system at the time. Designed for 49 close Europa flybys after Jupiter orbit insertion.
